additional_details: This vulnerability is being disclosed publicly without a patch in accordance with the ZDI 120 day deadline. 01/22/20 – ZDI disclosed the vulnerability report to the vendor onsite at Pwn2Own 04/22/20 – ZDI requested an update 04/23/20 – The vendor provided an update that the report was still in work 05/05/20 – ICS-CERT requested an update and the vendor replied no ETA was available 05/06/20 – ZDI agreed to wait until further notice 05/20/20 – ZDI requested an update and the vendor replied that there was no ETA 06/03/20 - ICS-CERT requested an update and the vendor replied no ETA was available 06/04/20 – ZDI notified the vendor and ICS-CERT that the report would be published as a 0-day advisory on 06/15/20 -- Mitigation: Given the nature of the vulnerability, the only salient mitigation strategy is to restrict interaction with the service to trusted machines. Only the clients and servers that have a legitimate procedural relationship with the service should be permitted to communicate with it. This could be accomplished in a number of ways, most notably with firewall rules/whitelisting.

Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of serialized data.
